branches.label: Appearance controls
branches.description: Choose light, dark, wallpaper, accent colors or conditional desktop themes.

branches.label: Sound controls
branches.description: Volume, mute, outputs, microphone, alerts and conditional per-app sound.

branches.label: Display controls
branches.description: Brightness, night colors, resolution, scale, layout, refresh, HDR and mirroring when supported.

branches.label: Connection controls
branches.description: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, VPN, Ethernet, hotspot, airplane mode, proxies and DNS.

branches.label: Notification controls
branches.description: Do Not Disturb, notification preferences and conditional focus schedules.

branches.label: Session controls
branches.description: Lock, sleep, sign out, switch user, restart or shut down. Preview only; never immediate execution.

branches.label: Power and battery
branches.description: Power preferences, battery status and conditional energy profiles or charge limits.

branches.label: Keyboard and pointer
branches.description: Keyboard layouts, repeat, shortcuts, mouse, touchpad and keyboard backlight where supported.

branches.label: Accessibility controls
branches.description: Screen reader, zoom, contrast, text size, color filters, motion and keyboard assistance.

branches.label: Privacy and permissions
branches.description: Review microphone, camera, location, screen-capture permissions and firewall settings. No grants inferred.

branches.label: Apps and maintenance
branches.description: Settings, files, clipboard, storage, trash, processes, default apps, updates and installed applications.

branches.label: Desktop and workspaces
branches.description: Virtual desktops, window layout and conditional Hyprland or Omarchy bar and binding preferences.

items.label: Switch to light mode
items.description: Use the operating system's light appearance or an installed light desktop theme.

support.macos: System Settings > Appearance: Light.
support.linux: GNOME or KDE appearance settings; other desktops require an explicit backend.
support.omarchy: An installed Omarchy theme with a light scheme is required; not a universal toggle.

items.label: Switch to dark mode
items.description: Use dark appearance or an installed dark desktop theme.

support.macos: System Settings > Appearance: Dark.
support.linux: GNOME or KDE appearance settings; desktop support varies.
support.omarchy: An installed Omarchy theme with a dark scheme is required.

items.label: Open appearance settings
items.description: Find theme, color, wallpaper and appearance controls.

support.macos: System Settings > Appearance.
support.linux: Installed desktop's appearance settings; no common Linux settings application.
support.omarchy: Omarchy theme menu; installed version and themes must be checked.

items.label: Choose an Omarchy theme
items.description: Browse installed Omarchy themes; the requested scheme must actually exist.

support.omarchy: Omarchy theme menu / omarchy-theme-set, only if installed. Theme names must come from discovery.

items.label: Adjust volume
items.description: Open output volume controls.

support.macos: System Settings > Sound or Control Center.
support.linux: Desktop sound settings; pactl or wpctl only with a matching audio service.
support.omarchy: PipeWire/WirePlumber volume controls if installed.

items.label: Choose audio output
items.description: Choose speakers, headphones or another sound output device.

support.macos: Sound > Output; devices must be enumerated.
support.windows: Sound > Output; devices and drivers must be available.
support.linux: PipeWire or PulseAudio device selection requires backend discovery.
support.omarchy: WirePlumber or desktop audio picker; actual device IDs must be discovered.

items.label: Choose microphone input
items.description: Open microphone selection and input level controls.

support.macos: Sound > Input; access to capture is a separate permission.
support.windows: Sound > Input; recording permission is separate.
support.linux: Desktop sound settings or an installed PipeWire/PulseAudio backend.
support.omarchy: WirePlumber input device controls when available; no recording grant.

items.label: Adjust brightness
items.description: Open brightness controls when the display hardware supports them.

support.macos: Displays settings for supported built-in/Apple displays; arbitrary external monitors need a separate backend.
support.windows: Display brightness slider only on supported displays/drivers.
support.linux: Desktop settings or brightnessctl when a backlight device and permissions exist.
support.omarchy: Supported backlight device via installed brightness controls; not arbitrary external monitors.

items.label: Open display settings
items.description: Find resolution, scaling and multiple-display arrangement.

support.macos: System Settings > Displays.
support.linux: GNOME/KDE display settings, or a compositor-specific backend.
support.omarchy: Hyprland monitor configuration; inspect actual monitors and config before changes.

items.label: Adjust night light
items.description: Open warm screen colors, Night Shift or Night Light where available.

support.macos: Displays > Night Shift on supported systems.
support.windows: Display > Night light when supported by the display driver.
support.linux: GNOME Night Light, KDE Night Color, or an explicitly installed equivalent.
support.omarchy: An installed compatible color-temperature service such as hyprsunset; not assumed present.

items.label: Turn on Do Not Disturb
items.description: Preview focus or notification suppression controls.

support.macos: Control Center > Focus; focus definitions must be discovered.
support.windows: Settings > System > Notifications > Do not disturb.
support.linux: Desktop/notification-daemon-specific Do Not Disturb support.
support.omarchy: Installed notification daemon's DND control, for example mako mode if supported.

items.label: Choose a Wi-Fi network
items.description: Open wireless network selection; no credential handling or connection occurs.

support.macos: Wi-Fi settings or Control Center; wireless hardware required.
support.linux: Desktop network panel or NetworkManager when installed.
support.omarchy: NetworkManager picker when installed; hardware and service must be checked.

items.label: Open Bluetooth devices
items.description: Review pairing or connection settings for Bluetooth devices.

support.macos: System Settings > Bluetooth; adapter required.
support.linux: BlueZ plus a desktop picker when available.
support.omarchy: BlueZ and an installed Bluetooth picker; no automatic pairing.

items.label: Open VPN settings
items.description: Inspect configured VPN connections; do not infer or expose credentials.

support.macos: VPN settings; configured profiles or a provider app required.
support.windows: Network & internet > VPN or provider app.
support.linux: NetworkManager VPN support depends on installed plugins/provider.
support.omarchy: Installed NetworkManager VPN plugins or provider; not universal support.

items.label: Open system settings
items.description: Open the platform's settings or control interfaces.

support.macos: System Settings application.
support.linux: Installed desktop settings application; no common Linux implementation.
support.omarchy: Omarchy configuration menu where installed.

items.label: Lock the screen
items.description: Preview locking the current desktop session; nothing is locked here.

support.macos: Native Lock Screen operation; user session required.
support.windows: Native workstation lock; interactive user session required.
support.linux: Desktop session lock or loginctl only when a session locker is available.
support.omarchy: Installed Hyprland-compatible locker such as hyprlock; not assumed running.

items.label: Open power settings
items.description: Open battery, sleep and energy preferences.

support.macos: Battery or Energy settings depending on hardware.
support.linux: Desktop power settings; installed power services and hardware vary.
support.omarchy: Installed power settings/service; battery controls require battery hardware.

items.label: Open the file browser
items.description: Open Finder, Explorer or the configured Linux file manager.

support.macos: Finder.
support.linux: Discovered default file manager / desktop association.
support.omarchy: Configured file manager; package choice must be discovered.

items.label: Open clipboard controls
items.description: Find supported clipboard history or settings; contents are not captured.

support.macos: macOS version-dependent clipboard history, or an explicitly installed manager; no universal history API.
support.windows: Clipboard settings / Windows clipboard history when enabled.
support.linux: Installed clipboard manager; Wayland/X11 support and permissions vary.
support.omarchy: Installed Wayland clipboard manager such as cliphist; not assumed available.

items.label: Take a screenshot
items.description: Preview capture of a visible desktop or window with required permission.

items.label: Read the selection aloud
items.description: Speak deliberately selected text; only offered when the fixture has a selection.

items.label: Transcribe audio
items.description: Transcribe the audio available in this fixture.

items.label: Start dictation
items.description: Choose the dictation interface to turn speech into text.

items.label: Open Oqto
items.description: Open the agent workspace interface.

items.label: Add a task
items.description: Add a reminder or todo using the user's input text.

items.label: Search past conversations
items.description: Look up a prior discussion or agent session.

items.label: Find a saved memory
items.description: Find a remembered preference or operational fact.

items.label: Search project issues
items.description: Find a tracked bug, feature or task.

items.label: Choose wallpaper
items.description: Review desktop wallpaper or background preferences.

support.macos: System Settings > Wallpaper.
support.linux: Installed desktop's background settings.
support.omarchy: Installed Omarchy background controls; wallpaper source must be discovered.

items.label: Choose accent color
items.description: Review supported accent or highlight colors.

support.macos: Appearance > Accent/Highlight color.
support.linux: Desktop/version-specific accent or theme color settings.
support.omarchy: Theme-derived colors; arbitrary accent editing is not assumed supported.

items.label: Schedule light and dark
items.description: Review automatic appearance schedules where supported.

support.macos: Appearance > Auto.
support.windows: No universal built-in theme scheduler; an explicitly installed scheduling utility is required.
support.linux: Desktop extension or installed scheduler; not universal GNOME/KDE support.

items.label: Mute sound output
items.description: Preview muting the selected sound output.

support.macos: Native output mute controls.
support.linux: Discovered PipeWire/PulseAudio or desktop backend.
support.omarchy: Installed WirePlumber output mute controls.

items.label: Mute microphone
items.description: Review input mute controls; software mute is not a hardware privacy guarantee.

support.macos: No universal system-wide input mute switch; input level or an explicitly installed utility is required.
support.windows: Input device mute/level support depends on device and driver.
support.linux: PipeWire/PulseAudio input mute when supported.
support.omarchy: WirePlumber source mute if installed; does not grant recording permission.

items.label: Adjust per-app volume
items.description: Review an application sound mixer when available.

support.macos: Requires an explicitly installed per-app audio utility; no standard native mixer.
support.linux: Desktop mixer or pavucontrol with a compatible audio service.
support.omarchy: Installed PipeWire-compatible mixer such as pavucontrol.

items.label: Adjust alert sounds
items.description: Review notification and system-event sound preferences.

support.macos: Sound > Sound Effects.
support.windows: Sound control panel > Sounds; app notification sounds may be separate.
support.linux: Desktop sound-theme and notification preferences.
support.omarchy: Notification daemon/app configuration; not a universal alert-volume control.

items.label: Choose resolution
items.description: Review modes supported by the selected display.

support.macos: Displays settings; supported modes must be enumerated.
support.windows: Display settings; supported modes and drivers required.
support.linux: Desktop display settings or compositor-specific monitor configuration.
support.omarchy: Hyprland monitor configuration; actual output names and modes required.

items.label: Adjust display scale
items.description: Review UI scaling for the selected display.

support.macos: Displays > scaling/resolution choices.
support.linux: Desktop/compositor scaling; fractional support varies.
support.omarchy: Hyprland monitor scale; installed configuration must be inspected.

items.label: Arrange monitors
items.description: Review display positions and primary display selection.

support.macos: Displays > Arrange; multiple displays required.
support.linux: Desktop/compositor-specific output arrangement.
support.omarchy: Hyprland monitor positions; detected monitor identifiers required.

items.label: Choose refresh rate
items.description: Review supported refresh rates or variable refresh preferences.

support.macos: Displays settings where display/hardware supports rates.
support.linux: Desktop/compositor-specific supported display modes.
support.omarchy: Hyprland monitor mode/VRR support; hardware and version dependent.

items.label: Review HDR settings
items.description: Review HDR only for compatible displays and rendering stacks.

support.macos: Displays HDR option on supported external displays/hardware.
support.windows: Display > HDR; compatible display, GPU and drivers required.
support.linux: Desktop/compositor/version-specific HDR support; not universal Linux support.
support.omarchy: Hyprland/version-specific HDR configuration; output and rendering support must be verified.

items.label: Rotate display
items.description: Review display orientation where supported.

support.macos: Display rotation availability varies by display and hardware.
support.linux: Desktop/compositor output transform.
support.omarchy: Hyprland monitor transform for detected outputs.

items.label: Mirror or extend displays
items.description: Review multi-display mirroring or extended desktop layout.

support.macos: Displays > Use as/Mirror; multiple outputs required.
support.linux: Desktop/compositor-specific mirroring support.
support.omarchy: Hyprland mirror configuration where supported by installed version.

items.label: External monitor brightness
items.description: Review external-display brightness through supported DDC/CI or vendor controls.

support.macos: Supported Apple displays or an explicitly installed DDC utility; monitor compatibility varies.
support.windows: Monitor/vendor utility or an explicitly installed DDC backend.
support.linux: ddcutil only if installed and DDC/CI/I2C hardware access is permitted.
support.omarchy: Installed DDC backend and monitor support required; brightnessctl alone is insufficient.

items.label: Review wired network
items.description: Review Ethernet adapter and connection settings.

support.macos: Network > Ethernet service when present.
support.linux: Desktop settings or NetworkManager connection profiles.
support.omarchy: Installed NetworkManager wired profile; interface discovery required.

items.label: Review airplane mode
items.description: Review radio-disable controls; wired and Bluetooth behavior varies.

support.windows: Network & internet > Airplane mode on supported hardware.
support.linux: Desktop radio controls or rfkill when supported; privilege/hardware dependent.
support.omarchy: Installed rfkill/radio controls; supported hardware required.

items.label: Review hotspot sharing
items.description: Review internet sharing or mobile hotspot without enabling it.

support.macos: General > Sharing > Internet Sharing; upstream/downstream interfaces and permissions required.
support.windows: Network & internet > Mobile hotspot on supported hardware.
support.linux: NetworkManager hotspot support depends on Wi-Fi hardware and drivers.
support.omarchy: Installed NetworkManager and access-point-capable hardware required.

items.label: Review proxy settings
items.description: Review configured system/network proxies; no credentials are inspected.

support.macos: Network service > Details > Proxies.
support.linux: Desktop/app-specific proxy settings; not a universal system-wide proxy.
support.omarchy: App/environment or installed network configuration; no universal global proxy UI.

items.label: Review DNS settings
items.description: Review DNS configuration for a discovered network connection.

support.macos: Network service > Details > DNS.
support.windows: Network adapter DNS settings; privileges may be required.
support.linux: NetworkManager/resolver-specific DNS configuration.
support.omarchy: Installed NetworkManager/resolver configuration; no assumed resolver service.

items.label: Forget a saved network
items.description: Preview removing a saved Wi-Fi profile; nothing is deleted.

support.macos: Wi-Fi known networks; actual profiles must be discovered.
support.linux: Installed network backend's saved connection profiles.
support.omarchy: NetworkManager saved profiles when installed; identifiers must be discovered.

items.label: Review sharing services
items.description: Review file sharing or local discovery services without enabling access.

support.macos: General > Sharing; each service has separate authorization.
support.windows: Advanced sharing settings; firewall/account configuration is separate.
support.linux: Installed Samba/NFS/discovery services; no universal sharing backend.
support.omarchy: Explicitly installed sharing services only; not shipped capability claims.

items.label: Open notification settings
items.description: Review notification delivery and display preferences.

support.macos: System Settings > Notifications.
support.linux: Installed desktop/notification daemon settings.
support.omarchy: Installed notification daemon configuration, often mako; version dependent.

items.label: Review app notifications
items.description: Review notifications for a discovered application.

support.macos: Notifications > selected app.
support.linux: Desktop/daemon-specific app notification rules.
support.omarchy: Installed notification daemon app rules; no universal per-app picker.

items.label: Schedule quiet hours
items.description: Review focus or Do Not Disturb schedules where supported.

support.macos: Focus schedules; actual focus profiles required.
support.windows: Notifications > automatic Do Not Disturb rules.
support.linux: Desktop/daemon-specific scheduling or an explicitly installed scheduler.
support.omarchy: Installed notification service/scheduler required; no assumed built-in schedule.

items.label: Put computer to sleep
items.description: Preview suspend/sleep; active work and session safety require separate confirmation.

support.macos: Native Sleep operation; hardware/power policy applies.
support.linux: Desktop/systemd suspend only when supported and authorized.
support.omarchy: Installed session/power service suspend; privilege and hardware dependent.

items.label: Sign out
items.description: Preview signing out; unsaved work is not closed here.

support.macos: Native Log Out with unsaved-work confirmation.
support.windows: Native Sign out; interactive user session required.
support.linux: Desktop/compositor session logout; unsaved work handling varies.
support.omarchy: Hyprland session exit via a discovered session backend; not executed.

items.label: Switch user
items.description: Review user-session switching without selecting an account.

support.macos: Fast User Switching when enabled.
support.windows: Switch user when available under device policy.
support.linux: Display-manager/desktop-dependent user switching.
support.omarchy: Installed display/session manager support required.

items.label: Restart computer
items.description: Preview restart; separate explicit authorization and unsaved-work checks required.

support.macos: Native restart with confirmation; policy may restrict it.
support.linux: Desktop/logind reboot subject to privilege and session policy.
support.omarchy: Installed session/power backend reboot subject to policy; no execution.

items.label: Shut down computer
items.description: Preview shutdown; nothing is stopped or powered off.

support.macos: Native shutdown with confirmation.
support.windows: Native shutdown; privilege and policy apply.
support.linux: Desktop/logind power-off subject to authorization.
support.omarchy: Installed session/power backend; separate authorization mandatory.

items.label: Review startup apps
items.description: Review login/startup applications without modifying service definitions.

support.macos: General > Login Items & Extensions; no launchd edits.
support.windows: Apps > Startup or Task Manager Startup apps.
support.linux: Desktop autostart settings; service management is a separate mechanism.
support.omarchy: Installed Hyprland/autostart configuration; no assumed GUI or service editing.

items.label: Adjust idle lock timeout
items.description: Review screen-off, idle and automatic-lock policies.

support.macos: Lock Screen settings; managed policy may restrict changes.
support.windows: Power/screen timeout and sign-in requirements are separate settings.
support.linux: Desktop/session idle and locker settings; service dependent.
support.omarchy: Installed hypridle/locker configuration; actual service must be discovered.

items.label: Choose energy profile
items.description: Review low-power, balanced or performance modes where available.

support.macos: Battery/Energy power modes depend on Mac hardware.
support.windows: Power mode availability depends on power plan/hardware.
support.linux: power-profiles-daemon or another discovered provider; profiles vary.
support.omarchy: Installed power profile provider and supported hardware required.

items.label: Review battery health
items.description: Review battery charge, health and usage when battery hardware exists.

support.macos: Battery settings on supported battery-powered Macs.
support.windows: Power & battery; detailed health may require battery report/provider.
support.linux: Desktop/UPower battery data only if hardware/provider exposes it.
support.omarchy: Installed battery/UPower backend; absent on battery-less devices.

items.label: Review charging limits
items.description: Review optimized charging or a supported battery charge threshold.

support.macos: Optimized Battery Charging where supported; arbitrary thresholds may require a separate utility.
support.windows: OEM-specific battery utility/firmware; no universal Windows charge-limit control.
support.linux: Hardware/driver-specific charge thresholds and permissions required.
support.omarchy: Hardware-specific charging backend; not a generic Omarchy feature.

items.label: Choose keyboard layout
items.description: Review input languages and keyboard layouts.

support.macos: Keyboard > Text Input > Input Sources.
support.linux: Desktop keyboard layout settings; X11/Wayland backend varies.
support.omarchy: Hyprland keyboard/input configuration; installed layouts must be discovered.

items.label: Adjust key repeat
items.description: Review keyboard repeat delay and repeat rate.

support.macos: Keyboard repeat settings.
support.linux: Desktop or compositor-specific keyboard repeat settings.
support.omarchy: Hyprland keyboard repeat configuration; installed version dependent.

items.label: Review keyboard shortcuts
items.description: Review native desktop shortcut bindings without changing them.

support.macos: Keyboard > Keyboard Shortcuts.
support.windows: Windows/app shortcuts; no single native editor for all system bindings.
support.linux: Desktop/compositor keyboard shortcut settings.
support.omarchy: Installed Omarchy/Hyprland bindings; explicit local config inspection required.

items.label: Adjust mouse settings
items.description: Review pointer speed, buttons and scrolling for detected mice.

support.macos: Mouse settings when supported mouse hardware is present.
support.linux: Desktop/input-provider settings; hardware features vary.
support.omarchy: Hyprland/libinput configuration for discovered devices.

items.label: Adjust touchpad settings
items.description: Review touchpad sensitivity, gestures and natural scrolling when supported.

support.macos: Trackpad settings when compatible hardware is present.
support.windows: Touchpad settings depend on hardware/precision drivers.
support.linux: Desktop/libinput touchpad configuration; gesture support varies.
support.omarchy: Hyprland/libinput touchpad configuration when hardware exists.

items.label: Adjust keyboard backlight
items.description: Review keyboard illumination when hardware exposes a supported control.

support.macos: Keyboard brightness control on supported backlit keyboards.
support.windows: OEM/device utility; no universal keyboard backlight API.
support.linux: Supported LED device via installed backend and permissions.
support.omarchy: Installed brightness/LED backend for an actual backlit keyboard.

items.label: Open accessibility settings
items.description: Review assistive technologies and interaction preferences.

support.macos: System Settings > Accessibility.
support.linux: Desktop accessibility settings; assistive packages may be separate.
support.omarchy: Installed assistive tools and compositor support; no universal accessibility panel.

items.label: Review screen reader
items.description: Review VoiceOver, Narrator or an installed screen reader; no activation occurs.

support.macos: Accessibility > VoiceOver.
support.linux: Installed Orca or equivalent, subject to desktop/application accessibility support.
support.omarchy: Installed screen reader plus actual Wayland/compositor/application accessibility support required.

items.label: Review screen magnifier
items.description: Review zoom or magnification controls where available.

support.macos: Accessibility > Zoom.
support.linux: Desktop-specific magnifier/zoom support.
support.omarchy: Hyprland/version-dependent cursor zoom or an installed magnifier; not universal.

items.label: Review high contrast
items.description: Review high-contrast themes or increased interface contrast.

support.macos: Accessibility > Display > Increase contrast.
support.linux: Installed desktop's high-contrast theme support.
support.omarchy: Compatible installed theme/application settings; no global high-contrast guarantee.

items.label: Adjust text size
items.description: Review readable text sizing where the platform or applications support it.

support.macos: Accessibility > Display text-size controls are OS/app dependent; not universal scaling.
support.linux: Desktop font/text scaling; app behavior varies.
support.omarchy: Application/font and compositor scaling; no universal text-only setting.

items.label: Review color filters
items.description: Review color-blindness filters or inversion where supported.

support.macos: Accessibility > Display > Color Filters/Invert colors.
support.linux: Desktop/compositor-specific color filters or installed assistive tool.
support.omarchy: Explicitly installed compositor/shader filter support; not assumed available.

items.label: Reduce desktop motion
items.description: Review system or compositor animation preferences, separate from ctx-bar motion.

support.macos: Accessibility > Display > Reduce motion.
support.linux: Desktop-specific animation settings.
support.omarchy: Hyprland animation configuration; version and user config must be discovered.

items.label: Review keyboard assistance
items.description: Review sticky keys, slow/filter keys and on-screen keyboards where supported.

support.macos: Accessibility > Keyboard.
support.linux: Desktop/input-stack assistive key support; packages may be needed.
support.omarchy: Installed assistive input/keyboard tools; not a universal Hyprland feature.

items.label: Open privacy settings
items.description: Review privacy and application permissions without granting access.

support.macos: Privacy & Security.
support.linux: Desktop/sandbox-specific privacy controls; no universal Linux permission store.
support.omarchy: Application/sandbox/portal-specific privacy controls; explicit backend required.

items.label: Review microphone permissions
items.description: Review application microphone access; do not begin recording or grant permission.

support.macos: Privacy & Security > Microphone.
support.windows: Privacy & security > Microphone; app/desktop-app controls differ.
support.linux: Sandbox/portal/audio-server policies vary; no universal per-app microphone permission panel.
support.omarchy: Installed sandbox/audio/portal policy; no global per-app grant mechanism assumed.

items.label: Review camera permissions
items.description: Review camera access without opening a camera stream.

support.macos: Privacy & Security > Camera.
support.linux: Desktop/sandbox/device permissions and portal support vary.
support.omarchy: Discovered sandbox/portal/device permissions; no assumed camera capture.

items.label: Review location permissions
items.description: Review location services without requesting or exposing location.

support.macos: Privacy & Security > Location Services.
support.linux: Desktop location settings/GeoClue when installed; app policy varies.
support.omarchy: Installed location service and app policy only; no global provider assumed.

items.label: Review screen capture access
items.description: Review capture authorization; neither permission nor a desktop screenshot is acquired.

support.macos: Privacy & Security > Screen & System Audio Recording, label varies with macOS version.
support.linux: Wayland portal/compositor authorization is backend-specific; X11 has a different security model.
support.omarchy: Installed xdg-desktop-portal/Hyprland capture backend and actual authorization required.

items.label: Review firewall settings
items.description: Review network access policy without changing rules or opening ports.

support.macos: Network > Firewall; admin policy may apply.
support.linux: Installed firewall manager such as firewalld/ufw; no universal default.
support.omarchy: Installed firewall service and privileges must be discovered; no assumed rules.

items.label: Review storage usage
items.description: Review disk space and storage settings; no files are deleted.

support.macos: General > Storage.
support.linux: Installed disk-usage/filesystem tools; mount permissions vary.
support.omarchy: Installed storage/disk-usage utility; no universal native panel.

items.label: Review Trash or Recycle Bin
items.description: Open discarded-file storage for review; do not empty it.

support.macos: Finder > Trash.
support.linux: Configured file manager's freedesktop Trash support when available.
support.omarchy: Installed file manager/trash implementation; not all CLI deletions use Trash.

items.label: Review running apps
items.description: Open process or resource monitoring; no process is terminated.

support.macos: Activity Monitor.
support.linux: Installed system monitor or process viewer.
support.omarchy: Configured process monitor such as btop when installed; no assumed package.

items.label: Review default apps
items.description: Review file and URL associations; no association is changed.

support.macos: Finder Open With / app-specific default handlers; no universal default-app panel.
support.linux: Desktop/xdg application associations; actual handlers must be discovered.
support.omarchy: Configured xdg/MIME associations; no universal GUI picker.

items.label: Review software updates
items.description: Open update status; no package, firmware or OS update is installed.

support.macos: General > Software Update; Homebrew/app stores are separate providers.
support.windows: Windows Update; application managers are separate.
support.linux: Distribution/package-manager-specific update interfaces.
support.omarchy: Installed Omarchy update tooling; no update invocation or package-manager assumption.

items.label: Review installed apps
items.description: Review installed applications and package sources without uninstalling anything.

support.macos: Applications/Storage and discovered package managers; no single authoritative inventory.
support.windows: Apps > Installed apps; other package sources require discovery.
support.linux: Distribution/Flatpak/Snap/package sources must be discovered separately.
support.omarchy: Installed system/AUR/Flatpak sources must be discovered; no package changes.

items.label: Choose a workspace
items.description: Review virtual desktops or workspaces; actual identifiers must be discovered.

support.macos: Mission Control/Spaces; no stable public universal automation API assumed.
support.windows: Task View virtual desktops; automation backend must be explicitly supported.
support.linux: Desktop/compositor workspace interfaces vary.
support.omarchy: Hyprland workspaces when installed and running; identifiers must be enumerated.

items.label: Move window to workspace
items.description: Preview moving a deliberately identified window; no current-focus claim or move occurs.

support.macos: Mission Control/Spaces UI; window identity/accessibility permissions are separate.
support.windows: Task View UI; automation support and exact window identity required.
support.linux: Desktop/compositor-specific window/workspace mechanism.
support.omarchy: Hyprland window/workspace dispatch only with discovered identities and separate authorization.

items.label: Review window tiling
items.description: Review window snapping or tiling preferences.

support.macos: macOS-version-specific window tiling/UI; no generic accessibility grant.
support.linux: Desktop/window-manager-specific tiling configuration.
support.omarchy: Installed Hyprland layout and tiling configuration; no automatic dispatch.

items.label: Review floating window
items.description: Preview a compositor-specific floating-window choice; no window is changed.

support.linux: Only an explicitly discovered tiling compositor/window manager with floating support.
support.omarchy: Hyprland floating support; exact window identity and separate permission required.
